Q: SELECT INTO USING UNION QUERY A:

One way to SELECT a UNIONed query into a table is to use a Common Table Expression (CTE).

WITH temp AS (
    SELECT * FROM TABLE1
    UNION
    SELECT * FROM TABLE2
)
SELECT *
INTO [NEW_TABLE]
FROM temp

Q: Rich snippet display issue in google search A:

It looks like you’ve correctly added structured data, but Google’s rich results don’t always show immediately. Here are a few points to keep in mind:

  1. Google needs time to re-index pages
    Even after fixing schema, it can take days or weeks for rich snippets to appear in search results. The Rich Snippet Testing Tool shows validation, but search results update separately.

  2. Google only supports certain rich result types
    Currently supported types include:

    • Reviews

    • People

    • Products

    • Businesses and organizations

    • Recipes

    • Events

    • Music

    • Videos

    • Breadcrumbs

    Unfortunately, some types like general Place images or custom schemas may not appear as rich snippets.

  3. Check your markup for compatibility
    Make sure you are using supported schema types and correct properties. For Places, Google often prioritizes Organization or LocalBusiness schemas with image, address, and geo properties.

  4. Test your structured data with a validator
    You can test JSON-LD, Microdata, and see potential errors using SchemaValidator.org — it’s free and helps ensure your markup is correctly implemented.
